question.text:
Find the value of $A^3$ where $A=\left[\begin{array}{ccc}-1 & -1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 \\ 2 & 2 & 1\end{array}\right]$

  1. $\left[\begin{array}{ccc}-3 & 1 & 7 \\ -2 & -3 & -5 \\ 6 & 8 & 1\end{array}\right]$
     
  2. $\left[\begin{array}{ccc}3 & 5 & -1 \\ 1 & -9 & 1 \\ -2 & -4 & -5\end{array}\right]$
     
  3. $\left[\begin{array}{ccc}3 & 5 & -1 \\ -2 & -9 & 1 \\ -2 & -4 & -5\end{array}\right]$
     
  4. $\left[\begin{array}{ccc}3 & 5 & -1 \\ -1 & -9 & 1 \\ -2 & -4 & -5\end{array}\right]$
question.subject: Linear Algebra
